abstract: One hundred and fifty-six thoracic operations have been performed over an 8-year period, from 1980 to 1987, for 118 patients with pulmonary metastases. In 27 instances, the disease has been bilateral requiring a midline approach or sequential lateral thoracotomies. Resection was achieved by wedge excision in 74%, lobectomy in 16%, pneumonectomy in 4%, lobectomy plus wedge excision in 2%, bilobectomy in 1%, segmentectomy in 2% and segmentectomy plus wedge excision in 1%. The operative mortality for the group as a whole was 1.6% per patient (70% confidence limits CL. 0.6%-4.2%) and 1.2% per operation (70% CL. 0.5-3.2%). Actuarial survival for the histological subgroups at 2 and 5 years were: carcinoma 50% (+/- 11% standard error) and 35% (+/- 12%), sarcoma 59% (+/- 10%) and 51% (+/- 12%), teratoma 89% (+/- 5%) and 84% (+/- 7%) respectively. No patient following resection for metastatic melanoma was alive at 2 years. The survival in the teratoma group was significantly higher than in the other groups (P less than 0.001 carcinoma; P less than 0.01 sarcoma; P less than 0.001 melanoma). Survival in all groups was significantly greater than for the melanoma group. Metastasectomy is well tolerated by the patient. Worthwhile longterm survival is obtained in those patients in whom the primary disease has been controlled and all secondary disease is encompassed by the proposed surgery.
abstract_ja: 1980年から1987年の8年間に、118例の肺転移に対して156回の胸部手術を施行した。両側性病変が27例で、正中切開または連続的な側方開胸を要した。切除術式は楔状切除が74%、肺葉切除が16%、肺全摘が4%などであった。全体の術死亡率は患者あたり1.6%(70%信頼区間0.6%～4.2%)、手術あたり1.2%(70%信頼区間0.5～3.2%)であった。組織型別の年次生存率は、癌腫が2年50%(標準誤差±11%)、5年35%(±12%)、肉腫が2年59%(±10%)、5年51%(±12%)、奇形腫が2年89%(±5%)、5年84%(±7%)であった。悪性黒色腫の切除後は2年時点で生存者がいなかった。奇形腫群の生存は他群より有意に良好であった(癌腫p<0.001、肉腫p<0.01、黒色腫p<0.001)。全群の生存は黒色腫群より有意に良好であった。転移巣切除は患者によく耐容された。原発巣が制御され、残存する病変がすべて手術の対象に含まれる患者では、意味のある長期生存が得られる。
